note: Recorded from a live Firebase AI Logic cloud check of the Portia sample lease in Judge Mode.
rawText:
[
  {
    "field": "depositAmount",
    "status": "RED",
    "title": "High Security Deposit",
    "reason": "The security deposit of 4625 USD is 2.5 months of rent, which exceeds typical one to two-month caps in many states.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Would you consider reducing the security deposit to align with typical state guidelines of one or two months of rent?",
    "playbookId": "US-DEP-01"
  },
  {
    "field": "lateFeeAmount",
    "status": "RED",
    "title": "High Late Fee",
    "reason": "The late fee of 150 USD is well above 5 percent of the monthly rent and may be viewed as an unreasonable penalty.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Can the late fee amount be adjusted to a lower percentage of the monthly rent, such as 5 percent?",
    "playbookId": "US-LATE-01"
  },
  {
    "field": "lateFeeGraceDays",
    "status": "RED",
    "title": "No Grace Period for Late Fees",
    "reason": "The lease charges a late fee immediately on day zero, while many states require a grace period of around five days.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Would you agree to add a five-day grace period before late fees begin accruing?",
    "playbookId": "US-LATE-02"
  },
  {
    "field": "noticePeriodDays",
    "status": "AMBER",
    "title": "Extremely Long Notice Period",
    "reason": "The notice period of 2700 days appears unusual and may be a data entry error or an excessively long requirement.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Could you clarify the correct notice period required to vacate at the end of the lease term?",
    "playbookId": "US-NOTICE-01"
  },
  {
    "field": "maintenanceResponsibility",
    "status": "RED",
    "title": "Extensive Tenant Maintenance Duties",
    "reason": "The lease makes the tenant responsible for all repairs except the roof and foundation, conflicting with the implied warranty of habitability in most states.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Can we clarify that the landlord remains responsible for major habitability repairs and structural maintenance?",
    "playbookId": "US-MAINT-01"
  },
  {
    "field": "earlyTerminationPenalty",
    "status": "AMBER",
    "title": "Three-Month Termination Penalty",
    "reason": "The early termination fee requires three months of rent plus amounts owed through possession recovery, which is a significant penalty.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Would you be open to reducing the early termination penalty or capping it if the unit is successfully re-rented?",
    "playbookId": "US-TERM-01"
  },
  {
    "field": "rawNotes",
    "status": "RED",
    "title": "Potentially Unenforceable Waivers",
    "reason": "The agreement includes liability waivers and attorney fee provisions that may be unenforceable under local tenant laws.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Could we review and remove the clauses waiving liability and requiring tenant payment of legal fees?",
    "playbookId": "US-CLAUSE-01"
  },
  {
    "field": "mandatoryFees",
    "status": "AMBER",
    "title": "Multiple Mandatory Monthly Fees",
    "reason": "There are four mandatory monthly fees totaling over 111 USD that increase the true monthly housing cost beyond the base rent.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Are all of these mandatory monthly technology, amenity, and trash fees included in the advertised price?",
    "playbookId": "US-FEE-01"
  },
  {
    "field": "autoRenewal",
    "status": "AMBER",
    "title": "Automatic Renewal Clause",
    "reason": "The auto-renewal is set to yes, which can automatically lock you into another term if notice deadlines are missed.",
    "askTheLandlord": "Will you provide a written reminder notice prior to the auto-renewal deadline taking effect?",
    "playbookId": "US-RENEW-01"
  }
]

approvedExtract.guestPolicy: Guests may not stay more than three nights in any calendar month without written consent.
approvedExtract.maintenanceResponsibility: Tenant is responsible for all repairs to the premises and appliances except structural repairs to the roof and foundation.
approvedExtract.earlyTerminationPenalty: Tenant must pay an early termination fee equal to three months of rent plus rent owed through the date Landlord recovers possession.
approvedExtract.rawNotes: Tenant waives liability claims against Landlord and must maintain renters insurance with at least 100,000 in liability coverage. Tenant agrees to pay Landlord's attorney fees in any dispute.

otherMoneyTerms.name: Daily Late Fee
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Additional daily late charge until paid in full, up to a maximum of 450.00 total per month.

otherMoneyTerms.name: Unauthorized Occupant Fee
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Per day charge for unauthorized occupants.

otherMoneyTerms.name: Pet Rent
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Monthly fee per pet if approved.
